title: Partitioning the Imperial Treasury
statement:
Two provincial governors must divide N treasure chests among themselves. The i-th chest contains gold coins valued at A_i.

Determine whether the chests can be divided into two disjoint subsets such that the total value of gold in both subsets is strictly equal.

Print YES if such a balanced division is possible, otherwise print NO.
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Second line: N space-separated positive integers.

sampleCases.explanation: Can be partitioned into [1, 5, 5] and [11], both summing to 11.
Total sum is 11 (odd), cannot be split equally.
